remaining_limits.detail: Untouched legacy TOCTOU oracle rejects WIN32_1921 during concurrent replacement; new observed real-attack fixture PASS is reported separately, not substituted.
Strict cumulative CPU contract unqualified; original budgets/tolerances/history unchanged, CPU_RATE/deadline cannot replace it.
Trusted local library is not a hostile-process sandbox or qualified production deployment.
Real Node process termination/reopen tested; Windows reboot, power loss and directory durability not qualified.
No real Provider/credential/key/cost; all mock usage explicitly simulated.
Explicit file reconciliation does not itself release old Gateway/Worker/unknown resources; no automatic replay.
No automatic version/Artifact GC, deletion proof, or disk ownership destruction; capacity retained conservatively.
No long-term resident service, autonomous priority coordinator, Git watcher or full M1.7 autonomy qualification.
Gate-to-write bridge binds one file Artifact hash; no distributed or multi-file transaction claim.
